blocks.title: Files changes
blocks.summary: 7 related files share the "files" change signal.

explanations.title: Pass review scope from the Action
explanations.summary: The GitHub Action now passes the generated scope file to the comment publisher, so CI pull-request comments include the partial-review warning when applicable.

explanations.title: Record review coverage
explanations.summary: The output now records how many files were reviewed and which were skipped, giving downstream reporting a way to distinguish a partial review from a complete one.

explanations.title: Bounded reviews can be partial
explanations.summary: Large changes no longer fail just because their diffs exceed the review budget. By default, at most 40 files and 120,000 diff bytes are selected, prioritizing riskier paths and smaller diffs; zero disables a limit. Files that do not fit are left out of the diff, though the model may still access them through its tools.

explanations.title: Warn on partial reviews in PR comments
explanations.summary: When scope data lists skipped files, the pull-request summary now leads with a partial-review warning and names up to ten omitted files. With no skipped files—or no scope file—the warning is absent.
